_meta.description: Court formatting rules — drives cause-title, party designations, prayer language, verification format
_meta.change_protocol: CLO sign-off required for any change. Vishal raises Jira tickets to Ajay for additions; never edits unilaterally.

designation: IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT PATNA
jurisdictionNote: High Court for the State of Bihar. Has original, appellate, and writ jurisdiction. Hears anticipatory bail under S.482 BNSS, criminal appeals, writ petitions under Article 226/227, and civil appeals.
cause_title_format:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT PATNA
{caseNomenclature}

{petitioner} ... PETITIONER(S)

VERSUS

{respondent} ... RESPONDENT(S)

party_designation.state: State of Bihar through the Principal Secretary, Home Department, Government of Bihar, Patna

case_nomenclature.first_appeal: Appeal from Original Decree No. _____ of {year}

prayer_language.opening: It is, therefore, most humbly prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to:
prayer_language.closing: And for this act of kindness, the petitioner shall ever pray.

verification_format:
I, {deponent_name}, {designation}, do hereby solemnly affirm and state that the contents of paragraphs 1 to {body_para_count} of the above petition are true and correct to the best of my knowledge and belief and nothing material has been concealed therefrom.

Verified at {place} on this {date}.

DEPONENT

localRules: All petitions must be filed through an advocate enrolled with the Bar Council of Bihar or an AOR.
Anticipatory bail applications must be accompanied by a duly sworn affidavit.
Certified copy of the impugned order must be annexed.
All copies to be legible and paginated.
